Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

Validation: list the relevant offline checks and any unavailable verification.

For evaluator or fixture changes, identify the suite/evaluator versions and affected comparison cohorts. Include a synthetic regression example and explain how existing reports should be rescored.

For adapters, declare capabilities, evidence authority, isolation, and cleanup. No proprietary implementations or credentials belong in this repository. Live execution and score publication require separate explicit authorization; a pull request is not that authorization.
